item.title: 【環境】 Improved forest protection at Chinese heritage relic sites
item.description: Deforestation over the past century represents a crucial challenge for biodiversity conservation, but whether biocultural sites can improve conservation outcomes is still unclear. This study examines biocultural sites across China to test how these influence forest conservation outcomes.
